programme.title: Blue World S8 - "Bull Sharks of Florida"
programme.desc: Jonathan, and his camera operators, take a transmitter into a Florida cave while other staff members walk in the forest above with a receiver, to learn where the aquifer goes.

programme.title: Blue World S8 - "Horse Ferry Shipwreck"
programme.desc: Jonathan explores the wreck of a horse-powered ferry, the only known wreck of its kind in the world. Then Blue World travels to Jackson Blue Springs in Marianna, Florida, where we dive with world-renown cave rescue diver Edd Sorenson.

programme.title: Return Of The Spider Monkeys
programme.desc: A baby spider monkey named Infinity was stolen from the forest. After a 7-year rehabilitation, she is ready to return to the wild. She joins a makeshift group of orphaned monkeys and her newborn baby.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Wolves"
programme.desc: With populations steadily decreasing for decades prompting the forced reintroduction of wolves where the population has disappeared entirely, conservationists worldwide are struggling to keep the wolf alive and well.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Lizards"
programme.desc: Over hundreds of millions of years, they existed here long before us. Surviving natural disasters and mass extinctions, the are now among the oldest animals on earth.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Penguins"
programme.desc: Despite popularity, it seems the future does not bode well for the penguins, finding themselves in a shrinking world of melting snow and ice. However, they remain on the shores of our beaches and on the unforgiving Antarctic ice shelves and oceans.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Bears"
programme.desc: Bears today are divided into 8 species with some considered the largest land predators, though many are in fact omnivorous. They survive in our grasslands and mountains, tropical jungles and the cold harsh climate of the Artic.

programme.title: Ocean Vet S1 - "The Bermuda Black Grouper"
programme.desc: Neil combines his veterinary knowledge and dive skills to assist the Bermuda department of fisheries on a exciting and dangerous mission to protect the breeding grounds of the Bermuda black grouper.

programme.title: Ocean Vet S1 - "Night Sharks"
programme.desc: Follow Neil and his team as they perform a surgical procedure to implant an acoustic tag in the abdomen of a juvenile tiger shark in a bid to reveal how often these animals return close to Bermuda’s shores at night.

programme.title: Ocean Vet S1 - "Humpback Whale"
programme.desc: Watch Neil and his team swim with these ocean giants in a mesmerising and magical sequence as Neil comes face to face with one of the most intelligent mammals in the ocean.

programme.title: Frontier Vets S1 - "Will Ripple Lose a Leg"
programme.desc: Dr. Greg forces the students to attend a local Heritage Festival – something none of them are in the mood for on their ‘day off’. But will their attitudes change after witnessing the South African dance and folk customs?

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Helping Hands"
programme.desc: In this episode, we dive with dozens of bull sharks in Fiji. We then head to South Florida to plant native mangroves in an area of need. The journey ends with a trip to Maui.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Formations"
programme.desc: In this episode, Cousteau explores some of our planets most incredible natural formations.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Sports & The Environment"
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to the intersection of sports and our environment.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Student Explorer"

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Super Spider Silk"

programme.title: The Tech Effect S1 - "The Environment"
programme.desc: In this episode we look at some of the ways technology is helping us solve the big environmental problems of our age.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "Sports"

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "Medicine"
programme.desc: From physical examination, and surgery to Psychotherapy and Autism treatment. Even Traditional Chinese medicine can be practiced on VR.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "Future of VR"
programme.desc: In this episode, we make some virtual friends, have some virtual meetings, do some virtual research.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "The Longevity Gene"
programme.desc: Studying the genes and lifestyles of centenarians. The results may offer answers to living longer and fighting diseases.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "The Science Of Water Sustainability"
programme.desc: Looking at solutions for water scarcity from fog catching nets to water efficient washing machines.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "The Science Of Sugar"
programme.desc: Exploring the correlation between sugar intake and heart disease in young adults.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "Saving The Reef"
programme.desc: A look at how cross-breeding and manipulating corals to withstand warmer sea temperatures and more acidic condition could save coral reefs.

programme.title: Trains That Changed The World S1 - "World On The Move"
Trains That Changed The World S1 - "Supertrains"
War Machines S1 - "Ultimate Annihilation"

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "The Humanoid Robots"

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "Bioinspired Robots"

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "City of the Future"
programme.desc: By the year 2050, three qarters of the world's population will live in urban areas. Looking at robotic systems being developed worlwide we can take a glimpse at the city life of the future.
